*Baseline: 2026-09-29 (30-day default; no prior baseline report exists in this folder, so everything in the window is treated as new). Analyzed 8 videos (7 uploaded 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-28, plus djDt8J2_YVs, published 2026-09-26, three days before the window and included deliberately), plus Anthropic primary sources (newsroom, API release notes, Claude Code changelog v2.1.285–v2.1.312, read in full).*

**Evidence labels used throughout.** `P` = Anthropic primary file (newsroom.md, api-release-notes.md, cc-changelog.md). `OV` = official-channel video, human captions. `SV-h` = staff talk, human captions. `SV-a` = staff talk, auto-captioned (D-SVFneJ_Nk, AnsXWH2_EBU, ZkDRXs_LvWw): content is reliable, exact wording is not, so I paraphrase. `M` = description-only metadata for a short upload. `GD` = Grok-comparison tier (stated in that section).

## Executive Summary
- **Claude Haiku 5.5 launched 2026-10-07** (`claude-haiku-5-5`): 1M context, $0.10 in / $0.50 out per MTok for prompts of 100K tokens or less, $0.50 / $2.50 above; it is now the default `haiku` alias in Claude Code (v2.1.293). Sonnet 5.5 cache reads were cut from $0.20 to $0.10 the same day. [P: newsroom.md, api-release-notes.md, cc-changelog.md]
- **Anthropic is pushing always-on, multi-agent surfaces**: Claude Tag (Slack), Claude Code Projects (beta, Pro/Max), cloud sessions, Managed Agents dynamic workflows (beta, 10-09) and Claude Duet (research preview, waitlist). Cherny describes Tag and Projects as the bets that may eventually replace Claude Code itself. [P; _f_rtbW_uFM, omihvjf0A2k OV; djDt8J2_YVs SV-h]
- **Claude Code gained Mods (v2.1.287, 2026-10-01)**, plugins that change rendering, prompts and tool calls, alongside idle compaction, default-on fork subagents, review levels (Quick/Standard/Deep) for the GitHub Code Review service (v2.1.304; org-level, PR-based, distinct from the local `/code-review` command) and a cluster of Windows PowerShell hook fixes. [P: cc-changelog.md; yUuFvL1lK4k OV]
- **Platform and ecosystem**: API version 2026-10-21 with major-version SDKs (Apache 2.0), Agent Skills donated to the Agentic AI Foundation (10-22), Sonnet 4.5 retirement set for 2026-11-30, and an S-1 filing (10-26). [P: api-release-notes.md, newsroom.md]
- **Grok comparison (first run)**: the only clean independent head-to-head is LMArena WebDev (2026-10-27, models only), Claude Opus 5.5 1810 vs Grok 4.7 1637. Grok Bot is a different product category from Claude Code and has no independent benchmark. [GD]

## NEW Features / Releases

**Models**
- Haiku 5.5: first Haiku-class model with an effort parameter; 128k max output; adaptive thinking on by default; on Claude API, Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry. Breaking changes vs Haiku 4.5 return 400s: manual `budget_tokens`, `temperature`/`top_p`/`top_k`, assistant prefill, `computer_20250124`. [P: api-release-notes.md 10-07]
- Opus 5.5 fast mode left research preview 2026-10-15 (no access request; header optional); also on Microsoft Foundry. The "(research preview)" label was removed from `/fast` in v2.1.304. [P]
- Sonnet 4.5 (`claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`) deprecated; retirement on Claude API 2026-11-30. [P: api-release-notes.md 09-30]
- No Opus, Sonnet or Fable launch posts in the window. [P: newsroom.md]

**Claude Code CLI (v2.1.285–v2.1.312; 26 versions, the file contains no 2.1.297 or 2.1.298)**
- Mods (v2.1.287): a mod is a plugin whose `hook.json` gains a `modules` key pointing at a TypeScript file that registers functions on internal events (render, tool call, permission check, prompt), Express-middleware style; the demo hides email addresses on screen until hover. [P; yUuFvL1lK4k OV]
- Built-in "You should know" mod, a side agent that flags what you or Claude may miss (v2.1.287, first-party sessions with telemetry on). [P]
- Idle compaction (v2.1.299): a 200K+ token conversation idle about 54 minutes is compacted before the one-hour prompt cache expires; `"idleCompaction": false` turns it off. [P]
- Fork subagents on by default in `claude -p`, Agent SDK, desktop app and VS Code (v2.1.302); Agent tool gets an `effort` parameter (v2.1.292); subagent `autoCompactWindow` (v2.1.296). [P]
- Auto mode: `/auto-mode-setup` (v2.1.304), `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` (v2.1.302). Hooks: `onFailure: "block"` (v2.1.295). `ultrathink` now runs its turn at xhigh effort (v2.1.311). [P]
- Code Review: Quick / Standard (default) / Deep levels (v2.1.304); `@claude review stop` (v2.1.307). [P]
- Windows, relevant to this machine: PowerShell hooks now block on exit code 2 and fail closed when Git for Windows is missing (v2.1.299, v2.1.309, v2.1.310); git commands faster (v2.1.309, v2.1.304); exFAT/FAT32 write refusals fixed (v2.1.302); PowerShell tool finds plugin `bin/` commands (v2.1.302); stdio MCP servers shut down gracefully (v2.1.296). [P]

- MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 is negotiated by default for stdio servers (v2.1.292) and claude.ai connectors (v2.1.295); `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out. [P]

**Routines, cloud sessions, Projects**

- Cloud sessions: own VM, continue while you are away, start from phone; count toward plan limits with no separate compute charge. [M: nJMwXtD56mA]
- Cloud routines get an effort picker (v2.1.312); cloud sessions and Remote Control can be gated by Enterprise custom roles (v2.1.310). [P]

**Claude Tag (Slack)**
- Claude in a team channel: remembers channel instructions, works from its own accounts, logs every change, asks permission before acting on your behalf; Team and Enterprise. [OV: _f_rtbW_uFM]
- Changelog adds Slack Connect channels (off by default), Allow once/Deny cards, `!fast`, analytics and spend limits; API beta for Tag settings 2026-10-23. [P]

**Desktop and apps (descriptions only)**

**API and platform [P: api-release-notes.md]**
- API version 2026-10-21; SDK majors Python 2.0.0, TypeScript 1.0.0, Go 2.0.0, Java 3.0.0, C# 13.0.0, PHP 1.0.0, Ruby 2.0.0, ant CLI 2.0.0; breaking changes independent of API version; licence Apache 2.0 instead of MIT.
- Managed Agents: dynamic workflows (beta, `managed-agents-2026-04-01`, 10-09); scheduled deployments on Claude Platform on AWS (10-14); `web_fetch` limited to URLs already in session context (10-07, anti-exfiltration); org-level web fetch off switch (10-20).

## NEW Workflow Patterns
- **Adversarial review, then a judge.** Spin off several Claude threads whose only task is to prove the work wrong, then use another Claude to validate the criticisms; prefer hard outside evidence, because "the current session" is a poor judge of its own work. Rieseberg describes running it in Projects with five threads. [D-SVFneJ_Nk SV-a]
- **Verification evidence on every PR.** Claude does a first-pass review that exercises the change like a user (browser, end-to-end, linting); edit hooks study diffs; team taste lives in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md; humans check the agent's evidence (screenshots, video). [AnsXWH2_EBU SV-a, Osmani]
- **Give Claude raw data and tools, not curated slices**, and document tools well; "model experience" as a design test. Rieseberg's own caution: upfront setup cost is real. [D-SVFneJ_Nk SV-a]
- **Be sparing with skills.** Rieseberg says Anthropic's official guidance is to be careful because a skill's usefulness decays fast, and removing a skill can improve output; most useful where you have an eval. [D-SVFneJ_Nk SV-a]
- **Projects economics:** coordinator on low effort, threads on a smaller model, switch up for hard tasks; Projects burn plan limits faster than one session. [omihvjf0A2k OV]
- **Sandbox plus auto mode instead of yes/no prompts.** Cherny: prompts became "security theater"; a second model without conversation context judges each command. The sandbox is opt-in in Claude Code and on by default in Cowork. [djDt8J2_YVs SV-h]
- **One shared company agent in Slack** instead of one agent per person, built on Managed Agents (sandboxes, memory, session control); agent acts as a separate entity but on the requester's behalf for tool calls. Guests are Every staff, not Anthropic. [z7cNbsr3b5s OV]

## Contradictions vs baseline
n/a: no prior baseline report. Within-window contradictions between sources:
- **Auto mode default.** Krieger says every Claude Code session runs through the auto-mode classifier by default [ZkDRXs_LvWw SV-a]. The changelog says sessions with no permission mode start in `default` on third-party providers, telemetry-off or fresh installs (v2.1.302), reversing v2.1.285. Primary source wins: treat "on by default everywhere" as wrong, or at best true for some plans.
- **Prompt injection.** Cherny states the Claude Code prompt-injection success rate is "zero" because none could be demonstrated in a one-week bounty [djDt8J2_YVs SV-h]. Staff claim, no primary support in these files; the same sentence concedes vulnerabilities "probably still exist".
- **Captions.** "Opus 55" in the auto-captions is read as Opus 5.5; speaker surnames are garbled.

## Grok vs Claude Code
"Grok bot" currently means: **Grok Bot**, an always-on agent product (beta since 2026-08-11; `@bot` on X), per x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot and docs.x.ai/grok-bot/overview. X users also lump in **Grok Build** (agent CLI, early beta 2026-05-25, open-sourced 2026-07-15), the **Grok 4.7** model (2026-09-21), and Cursor-hosted use (Cursor is reported to be part of xAI's parent; deal terms unverified). No xAI-owned IDE found. [grok/vendor.md, GD tier 1]

**Reported and unverified, not stated as fact:** (1) xAI pages and staff now call the company "SpaceXSI"/"SpaceXAI". The files record that wording in an x.ai guide and footer, but the fetches were summarised by a small model, so I use "xAI". (2) Grok Bot routes tasks to Claude Opus 5.5 (a Musk post about 2026-10-07, secondary reports only; xAI docs do not confirm).

Tier key: vendor, affiliated, **independent**, sentiment. Fetches were summarised by a small model; every number below was checked against the file text.

**Changed since last run:** first comparison.
**Vendor claims contradicted by independent sources:** None found. Unresolved vendor-versus-vendor gaps: Terminal-Bench 4.0 for Fable 5.1 is 57.9 in xAI's table but 55.8 in Anthropic's, and xAI's 57.9 equals the figure Anthropic gives GPT-6 Astra; Artificial Analysis Grok 4.7 Index 34 versus a relay's 46. Anthropic's 66.4% (xhigh) vs the 64.8% mirror (max) is within stated error; xAI's 37.6 vs the 37.58 board entry is consistent. CursorBench is not neutral for xAI because Cursor is reported to be part of its parent.
**Bottom line for Greg's work:** On the one clean independent head-to-head (LMArena WebDev, 2026-10-27, models only) Claude Opus 5.5 leads Grok 4.7 by 173 points; Terminal-Bench points the same way but rests on mirrors, different harnesses and efforts, so I do not rank it. Both CLIs ship native Windows installers, but Claude Code has documented data terms and a run of Windows hook fixes in this window, while Grok Build's data terms were not found; Grok Bot is a general always-on work agent with no independent benchmark, and its nearest Claude equivalents (cloud sessions with routines, Tag, Duet) differ in tier and availability, so for solo local Python/R/.qmd work on Windows nothing in tier 1-2 evidence argues for switching from a local Claude Code session (inference).
